prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather
Asset type: reusable winter desktop-companion background, final vertical 1024x1536 image. Input image 1 is the composition and room-layout reference.
Primary request: preserve the same cozy contemporary Suzhou apartment reading-nook composition from Input image 1: tall window on the LEFT, ivory walls, light-oak floor, modest bookcase and plant at the far RIGHT, and a broad central empty floor. Change the view outside the LEFT window into a convincing real winter snowfall: bare decididuous branches visibly dusted with snow, snow collecting on distant traditional rooflines, softly falling snow, muted winter daylight. Remove all visible summer green foliage and blue-sky appearance. Keep the room warmly lit and inviting with warm ivory walls and natural wood tones, never a globally blue color grade.
Subject: empty interior, no person; wall art must contain no person or face.
Style/medium: high-quality photoreal interior photograph with natural winter exterior detail, real wood and plaster textures. No illustration, CGI, dollhouse, or miniature effect.
Composition/framing: vertical 2:3, chest-level moderate perspective, no fisheye. The center and foreground floor remain fully clear for an adult full-body composite or chair at x=0.22, y=0.12, width=0.60, height=0.82; keep the bottom 10 percent as clear plausible floor.
Lighting/mood: indoor soft warm daylight from upper LEFT through the winter window; warm interior/cool exterior contrast only.
Constraints: no people, no animals, no text, logo, watermark, or baked-in character. Do not add furniture or any foreground object into the central clear area.

qa.notes: The left window shows bare snow-covered branches, falling snow, and snow-covered distant rooflines. The room remains warm ivory and wood-toned, without a blue global grade; its central and foreground floor remain clear.
